name: oura-mcp-for-claude
description: Your own private, read-only Oura Ring MCP server for Claude (web, desktop and mobile), deployed to Cloudflare Workers with OAuth and a single-user lock.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores your Claude connector's OAuth grants (tokens are hashed; Oura tokens are encrypted). Keep the default name.

OURA_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your app at [developer.ouraring.com/applications](https://developer.ouraring.com/applications). No app yet? Enter `pending` and your Worker's home page will walk you through it after deploy.

OURA_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client Secret of the same Oura app (or `pending`). Kept as an encrypted Worker secret.

TIMEZONE.description: Your timezone as an IANA name, e.g. `Asia/Hong_Kong`, `Europe/London`, `America/New_York`. Used so "today" and "last 7 days" mean your days.
